Package Dither

Class ScatteringMat

java.lang.Object
Dither.ScatteringMat
Direct Known Subclasses:
Atkinson, FloydSteinberg, UniversalMat
public abstract class ScatteringMat extends Object
The ScatteringMat object contains a buffer in which error values are stored, and also defines the rule by which the error will be propagated.
